components.name: Workshop Action
components.description: Default measured action control for the workshop.
components.css: .ds-workshop-action { min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 0.82rem; border: 1px solid rgba(16,47,61,.19); border-radius: 3px; background: #f5f0e4; color: #102f3d; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(16,47,61,.08); font: 650 .86rem Sora, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-workshop-action:hover { transform: translate(-1px,-1px); border-color: #14627a; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(20,98,122,.18); } .ds-workshop-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14627a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-workshop-action:active { transform: translate(1px,1px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Active Workshop Action
components.description: Active command state for grid and workflow tools.
components.css: .ds-workshop-action { min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 0.82rem; border: 1px solid rgba(16,47,61,.19); border-radius: 3px; font: 650 .86rem Sora, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-workshop-action--active { background: #14627a; color: #f5f0e4; border-color: #102f3d; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(16,47,61,.2); } .ds-workshop-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0c453; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-workshop-action:active { transform: translate(1px,1px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Shape Tool
components.description: Square tile-shape selection card in the material rail.
components.css: .ds-shape-tool { display: grid; place-items: center; gap: .4rem; min-height: 64px; width: 100%; padding: .32rem; border: 1px solid #102f3d; border-radius: 3px; background: #f0c453; color: #102f3d; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(191,92,57,.22); font: 500 .64rem Sora, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-shape-tool__square { width: 1.8rem; height: 1.8rem; border: 2px solid currentColor; } .ds-shape-tool:hover { transform: translate(-1px,-1px); } .ds-shape-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14627a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-shape-tool:active { transform: translate(1px,1px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Material Rail
components.description: Blueprint-paper rail for material and tile controls.
components.css: .ds-material-rail { padding: 1.15rem; color: #102f3d; background: linear-gradient(rgba(16,47,61,.035) 1px,transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(16,47,61,.035) 1px,transparent 1px), #f5f0e4; background-size: 24px 24px; font-family: Sora,sans-serif; } .ds-material-rail__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; padding-bottom: .8rem; border-bottom: 2px solid #102f3d; } .ds-material-rail strong { font: 700 1.28rem 'Bodoni Moda',serif; } .ds-material-rail p { color: #14627a; font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-material-rail button { border: 1px solid rgba(16,47,61,.19); border-radius: 3px; background: #f5f0e4; color: #102f3d; font: 650 .76rem Sora,sans-serif; } .ds-material-rail button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14627a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Minimap Overlay
components.description: Compact canvas-edge world overview with a copper viewport frame.
components.css: .ds-minimap { width: min(15rem,100%); padding: .55rem; border: 1px solid rgba(16,47,61,.19); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(250,247,238,.95); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(16,47,61,.12); color: #14627a; font: 700 .82rem Sora,sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-minimap__track { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; margin-top: .35rem; border: 1px solid rgba(16,47,61,.19); border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(rgba(16,47,61,.07) 1px,transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(16,47,61,.07) 1px,transparent 1px), #e9dfca; background-size: 10px 10px; } .ds-minimap__viewport { position: absolute; left: 28%; top: 22%; width: 42%; height: 36%; border: 2px solid #bf5c39; background: rgba(191,92,57,.16); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #f5f0e4 inset; }

narrative.overview: Zzyix presents collaborative quilt editing as a craft workspace rather than a dashboard. Blueprint ink, ruled paper, copper markers, and exact rectangular instruments keep attention on the shared canvas while making material choices and spatial context readable at a glance. The canvas occupies the primary workspace. A compact material rail supplies tile controls, while status, collaboration, grid, and navigation tools stay at the canvas edges as contained overlays. The Pattern Workshop rules govern the authenticated quilt editor; older authentication and account-shell affordances are not reusable workshop primitives.
keyCharacteristics: Canvas-first layout with a fixed desktop material rail
Square, measured controls with small press movement
Narrow uppercase Sora labels paired with Bodoni Moda display text
Contained edge overlays that preserve the visible canvas

rules.name: The Blueprint Ground Rule
rules.body: Paper backgrounds carry a 24px blueprint grid; the grid supports orientation and never competes with tiles or text.

rules.name: The Marking Rule
rules.body: Copper and yellow identify a located, selected, or authored state. They are not general-purpose surface colors.

rules.name: The Drafting Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking belongs to compact Sora labels and status information; it does not replace the Bodoni display hierarchy.

rules.name: The Canvas Dominance Rule
rules.body: Workspace chrome may frame the canvas, but may not convert it into a padded card or consume its central field.

rules.name: The Instrument Rule
rules.body: Elevation implies a movable instrument or an overlay, not generic card decoration.

dos: Do keep the shared canvas as the largest uninterrupted surface
Do use paper grids to express the working-table material language
Do reserve blue for active workflow state and structured context
Do use copper and yellow for precise selection, location, and identity signals
Do keep mobile overlays intrinsically sized and edge-contained
donts: Don't round Pattern Workshop tools into pill-shaped controls
Don't place generic dashboard cards around the canvas
Don't use the blueprint grid as a competing decorative pattern
Don't let an overlay expand to the canvas height on narrow screens
Don't reuse legacy pill-shaped shell controls in editor workflows
